messages:
Tom Rivera: Hey team — urgent help needed for a SIG questionnaire the enterprise POC sent. They want evidence for A2 (Access control), A7 (Encryption at rest), and A10 (Backups & retention). Deadline is EOD Fri. Can security/eng confirm what we can provide?

Alex Chen: I got A2 and A7. For A2 we can share the IAM roles doc + RBAC diagram. Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/iam-rbac.

Maria Gomez: For customer-facing language on encryption, legal prefers the phrase: 'we use customer-isolated KMS keys with automatic rotation; audit logs retained per contract.' I'll craft a one-liner once we confirm key rotation evidence.

Jon Park: I can export the key rotation and backup manifests. Will run: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ops/evidence/key-rotation/rotation-last-365.csv ./` and `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/manifests/backup-manifest-2026-03.json ./`. Will upload to the evidence bucket for the customer.

Alex Chen: Uploaded A2 artifacts and preliminary A7 attestation to internal evidence bucket: `s3://redwood-evidence/sig/1756123456/`. Files: `A2-iam-roles.pdf`, `A2-rbac-diagram.png`, `A7-kms-attestation.pdf`. Note: A7 attestation is internal; Maria, can you confirm acceptable wording for external use?

Maria Gomez: Reviewed. For external delivery use this line: 'Encryption at rest is enforced via AWS KMS with customer-specific key policies; rotation is automated and logs are archived for 7 years per our retention schedule.' Approved.

Alex Chen: Also adding a short policy snippet for A2 that they asked for:
```
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"}}
  ]
}
```

Jon Park: Backup verification: `backup-manifest-2026-03.json` contains checksums + timestamps. I've pushed it to `s3://redwood-evidence/sig/1756123456/backup-manifest-2026-03.json`. Also exported last 365 days of rotation logs at `s3://redwood-evidence/sig/1756123456/rotation-last-365.csv`.

sig-bot: Created evidence package link for customer upload: https://evidence.redwood.ai/package/1756123456 (expires in 7 days).

Sara Patel: FYI I shared the package link with the customer's security contact: secops@acme.example. Said we'd follow up with any clarifications. :thumbsup:

Tom Rivera: Perfect — thank you all. I'll mark the SIG questionnaire as 'answered' on the portal and attach the package. If they come back asking for architecture-level diagrams, Alex can you add the network overlay diagram?

Alex Chen: Yep — adding `network-overlay-vpc.pdf` to the same folder in 10m.

Tom Rivera: Awesome. Closing loop: I'll update the CR with the evidence links and note SLA: 7-day expiry for the package. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
